column1: World Cup Toggle in Homepage Settings
column17:
Step Description: Open Firefox and navigate to Settings -> "Homepage"   Expected Result: The Homepage customization menu opens. Step Description: Locate the World Cup toggle Expected Result: The toggle is visible Step Description: Turn the World Cup toggle OFF and return to Homepage Expected Result: The World Cup banner (either the countdown or the "following" card) is no longer visible on the Homepage. The soccer ball is removed from the Firefox logo Step Description: Return to Settings -> Homepage and turn the toggle ON Expected Result: The setting is saved correctly. Step Description: Navigate back to the Homepage Expected Result: The banner is restored.
  • If no team was selected: The "Countdown" banner is displayed.
  • If a team was previously selected: The personalized "Following" card is displayed.
The Firefox logo will also include a soccer ball. Step Description: Verify persistence after app restart Expected Result: The toggle state remains as selected by the user (ON or OFF) after the application is closed and reopened. The Firefox logo will also include a soccer ball.
column18:
1. The Homepage customization menu opens. 2. The toggle is visible 3. The World Cup banner (either the countdown or the "following" card) is no longer visible on the Homepage. The soccer ball is removed from the Firefox logo 4. The setting is saved correctly. 5. The banner is restored.
  • If no team was selected: The "Countdown" banner is displayed.
  • If a team was previously selected: The personalized "Following" card is displayed.
The Firefox logo will also include a soccer ball. 6. The toggle state remains as selected by the user (ON or OFF) after the application is closed and reopened. The Firefox logo will also include a soccer ball.
